ModMetaData.name: Linux Performance Optimizations
ModMetaData.author: Anten Skrabec
ModMetaData.description:
Best-effort Linux integration for RimWorld 1.7.
Fresh defaults request startup Transparent Huge Pages and GameMode when available. CPU affinity reconciliation, periodic memory advice, bounded prefaulting, and file I/O hints are independent opt-in controls. Existing saved settings are preserved and may differ from fresh defaults.
The in-mod affinity policy applies to observed threads and is not a whole-game pinning guarantee; external launcher or cgroup policy is recommended for reliable placement. GameMode activation means the daemon accepted a request, not that its configuration pins CPUs. Native features skip safely when unsupported or unavailable. No specific performance gain is promised; benchmark a representative save.
Source: https://github.com/cebarks/rimworld-linux-misc
